name: fingerprint

versions.rationale: Identity matching (#20) needs to compare units that were edited as well as moved. One hash per internal node over that node and two levels below it keeps an edit local: Merkle subtree hashes changed every ancestor and missed resolveUnit's move in a5da380, which scores 0.68 this way.

docs: Shingle hashes of a normalised tree, one per internal node, as a sorted multiset for similarity.
